phase_prompt.summary: A cinematic sky over an ancient-tech city with luminous glyphs and floating monoliths.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic sky over an ancient-tech city, blending Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs with incomprehensible crystalline hardware; the heavens are a living tapestry of soft amber dawn or bright azure midday, featuring floating basalt monoliths etched with luminous glyphs, crystalline lattice spires emitting bio-luminescent haze, and subtle auroral ribbons, all rendered with grounded realism and tactile detail.
